_about: Auditorium geometry, version 2 (18 Nov 2026). Source: the team's hand sketch with tape measurements (floorplan/source-sketches/2026-11-18-hand-sketch-tape-measurements.jpg) and the team's answers the same day. Replaces version 1, which was read off the cable-planning tool and had the width and the runway length wrong; v1 is kept as floorplan/auditorium-dimensions-v1-cable-plan.json. Each value says how it is known: 'measured' = the team's tape measurement; 'derived' = arithmetic on measured values; 'not measured' = drawn where the sketch shows it, or carried over from v1, only so the plan can be drawn. Do not build to a 'not measured' value. 19 Nov 2026: room length, the console's position, heights and wall finishes added as estimates from the team's photos (see photo_estimates and docs/20-auditorium-from-photos.md); they are labelled 'estimated from photos'. 20 Nov 2026: room length revised to about 53 m (back wall about 47 m from the stage front) after the team said the floor past the golf limit is much longer than the photo estimate; the delay screen is two screens, one over each runway edge (team).

coordinate_system.origin: Corner of the stage end wall and the top wall, with the plan drawn stage-left as in the cable-planning tool

coordinate_system.z: Across the width, from the top wall (the 11.65 m side, team 18 Nov) to the bottom wall (the LF platform side)
coordinate_system.y: Up. Ceiling height not measured (photos suggest about 7.5-8.5 m).

auditorium.length_confidence: estimated (20 Nov): the team says the floor past the golf limit is much longer than the 19 Nov photo estimate, about twice as deep, so about 20 m. That puts the back wall about 47 m from the stage front (range 44-50 m); with the 6.0 m stage-depth placeholder the room is 53 m. It agrees with the old cable plan (54.7 m room; console 20.73 m past the runway tip, i.e. about 43.3 m from the stage front). The 19 Nov photo estimate (37 m) rested on assumed sizes: an 85-inch confidence monitor and exit signs at 2.3 m; a 110-inch monitor alone moves it to about 48 m. Not measured: tape the golf limit to the back wall to settle it.
auditorium.ceiling_confidence: estimated from photos (19 Nov): the side walls rise about 7.5-8 m to the black ceiling structure, using a 2.1 m door as the ruler; 8.5 m used for the ceiling deck, +-1 m

runway_side_items.note: The same on both sides (team 18 Nov): one set of stairs nearest the stage, then two speaker stands toward the tip. Speaker stands stick out 51.5 cm from the runway side (measured). Stair depth, the sizes of all six items and their positions along the runway are not measured: 'from_tip' is scaled off the sketch.

photo_estimates._about: From the team's photos of the auditorium in use (services, a 2020 event with house lights on), 19 Nov 2026. The photos aren't stored in the repo because they show identifiable people. Method and working: docs/20-auditorium-from-photos.md. Estimates, not measurements: build to none of them.
photo_estimates.floor: Light grey, smooth and slightly glossy (polished concrete or sheet vinyl look)

walls.top: Dark navy-black acoustic panels; a row of round surround speakers about 3.7 m up; two doors with exit signs; blue wall-wash lights near the top
walls.bottom: Dark wall with a long glazed band at floor level looking into a lit room (foyer?), roughly from x 9 to 31; beige diamond-quilted acoustic panels from about x 31 to the back wall; surround speakers; an exit door near the back corner
walls.back: Black drapes; the sound console in front; exit doors either side; a confidence monitor with a red clock hung over the console, facing the stage. The stage-view photos show four exit signs across the back, so there may be more doors than the sketch shows

ceiling.note: Black, exposed ducts and beams, a grid of black cylinder downlights hanging below it

side_trusses.note: Along both side walls, with white LED batons and moving heads; the LED batons are the white dashes in the stage-view photos

delay_screen.note: Two LED screens hung along the room, parallel to the runway, one above each runway edge, so about 2.4 m apart (team 20 Nov). Backs to each other: the one over the top edge faces the 11.65 m side, the one over the bottom edge faces the LF-platform side. Underside about 3.5 m (photos, 19 Nov); length and position along the runway are guesses. An unlit lattice section at the back end.

stage_set.led_wall: About 15 x 2.5 m, upstage, bottom about 1.8 m above the deck
stage_set.portrait_screens: Two each side: inner about 1.6 x 2.6 m hung, outer about 1.8 x 4.4 m standing near the curved corners
stage_set.line_arrays: Hung at the ends of the LED wall
stage_set.deck: Glossy pale grey, black fascia, light-blue LED strip along the front edge
stage_set.runway: Glossy white top, black skirt; black side stairs with four risers

photo_estimates.confidence_monitors: One over the console and one hung mid-room on the 11.65 m side, both facing the stage, each with a red LED clock

camera_heights.stage_view_photos: about 2.45 m above the stage deck
